hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a Uniswap v4 hook that implements a custom bilateral AMM curve backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes a quote using configurable price and concentration parameters, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another, and fully handles swap accounting via beforeSwapReturnsDelta — bypassing v4's native concentrated liquidity entirely.
